fusions.name: Long Hop Landing
fusions.desc: Bounds your ride onto a target up to 7 tiles away. It deals 12 damage, up to 2 times that at the far end of its reach, and stuns the target for 1 second.

fusions.name: Biting Hitchhiker
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Your passenger bites the target: it deals 7 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 2 seconds after.

fusions.name: Gap Jump
fusions.desc: Leaps you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away, with +10% dodge chance, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds after.

fusions.name: Sprung Seat
fusions.desc: Every time you dodge a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (27% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
